name: zopt_set_camera_mode
description: zOpt::SetCameraMode toggles the third-person game-control option bit and applies the corresponding Player camera state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zOpt/Player transition helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x407ec0 validates setting or clearing the 0x08 camera-mode bit and tail-calling Player::ApplyCameraState with third-person or first-person state.
The native smoke checks both enabled and disabled transitions through zOpt::SetCameraMode.
